name: Asymmetric Matrix Determinant Disguise
description: Replaced the simple quadratic divisibility condition with a 3x3 matrix determinant that includes the cable endpoints and the maximum of their elevations. Mathematically, the determinant evaluates to zero if and only if the elevations are equal, preserving the exact 3-coloring structure. However, the presence of the `max` function and the endpoint variables prevents simple algebraic factorization, forcing the model to either dynamically evaluate the constraint within its search (which breaks precomputation shortcuts) or fail to recognize the underlying graph structure entirely.
